title: SEC3: inconsistent cleanup pattern across test functions
description: The six test functions in crypto2dev_test.c use two different cleanup idioms. Simple tests (test_sha256_empty through test_aesgcm_empty) use early-return with inline free calls. The TLS integration tests use goto-done with *_inited flag guards. test_ecdsa_roundtrip uses neither — it uses nested scoped blocks and cascaded early returns. A reader maintaining these tests must hold three mental models simultaneously. Adopt a single pattern (goto-done with flags, or RAII-style cleanup at end) across all tests for uniformity.
